notes.title: Quanero 2 announced!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

We just announced "Quanero 2 - System Release" on Steam!

This is still a no-budget student project. Part of the equipment was provided to us by the University of Applied Sciences Salzburg, but we bear all the expenses for our actors and licenses. We are happy about every donation to cover our costs. So, if you like to help us out head over to www.quanero.com and hit the donate button!

We will use Steam and all other common social media platforms to keep you updated on the developement. We will also start streaming soon, but that will be an extra announcement. So make sure to follow us!

Twitter: twitter.com/Quanero2
FB: facebook.com/QuaneroSystemRelease
Reddit: reddit.com/user/Quanero2

Thanks a lot for your interest and your support!

Best wishes!

The Laserboys3000-Team

notes.title: Quanero now on the Oculus Rift CV1
notes.content:
We just released our latest Update. You are now able to play Quanero on the Oculus Rift CV1 with your Xbox Controller. Please keep in mind that we only support the consumer version and not the development kits. If you are playing Quanero with the Rift you will also notice that the supersampling option is disabeled. This won't change anytime soon since the Rift doesn't support this feature.

We hope you enjoy Quanero on the Rift!

notes.title: Quanero 1.1 - Added graphics settings
notes.content:
We released our first update. You're now able to adjust the graphics settings by pressing the left menue button. This menue can be opend everywhere in the game. This option is also explained in the tutorial.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25888328/20ddbe4c1a8e4323398e8a896926bbe0172e4e22.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25888328/9e38db98e9fc968130d0f88b846442a41e0f6f0f.png[/img][/url]

Options:

- type of antialiasing
- antialiasing quality
- resolution

A good configuration would be T.AA with a very high resolution, but please keep in mind that this very demanding. For less powerful systems FXAA is an reasonable option. FXAA gives a crisper image but also makes the edges look more jagged compared to T.AA.

notes.title: Blurriness and Resolution
notes.content: We are currently investigating why Quanero is blurry for some useres. Most likely we will switch the AA-method and implement some resolution settings in a future release!
